## Activity

This report covers activity at West Gate Eye Clinic for February 2026. The clinic recorded 356 captures during the reporting period. The activity total provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading performance for the month.

## Image quality

Of the captures recorded, 14 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 3.9%. These results are reported together to provide a clear summary of image quality at the site during February 2026.

## Grading

Grading identified 92 referable results. The median lag between capture and grading was 1 day. This indicates the midpoint of the recorded grading interval for the month. The activity, image quality and grading figures above provide the operational summary for West Gate Eye Clinic for February 2026.
